base:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: square Instagram educational carousel for Herramientas Rentables, Chilean freelancers. Create one finished, exceptionally polished editorial slide, 1:1, high resolution, meant to be read on a phone.
Visual identity: deep forest green #122B24, warm cream #F6F4EA, acid lime #D9FD64. Modern bold sans-serif typography with beautiful tight kerning, confident hierarchy, generous margins. Flat sharp print-quality shapes, precise alignment, subtle fine grain only. No photographs, no faux product screen, no buttons, no QR, no watermarks. Use the brand as a small text wordmark, not a invented graphic logo.
Only render the exact Spanish copy provided, including accents and punctuation. Every word must be easy to read, not a paragraph wall. Keep a consistent footer with "HERRAMIENTAS RENTABLES" and slide number. The scenario is educational and illustrative; no guaranteed income or client outcomes.

slides.name: P03_01.png
slides.body:
Primary request: carousel cover about scope creep. Dark forest green background. An oversized cream opening question, with "agregar" or the final phrase in lime. A clean abstract pair of offset proposal cards at the lower third visually suggests a small request expanding scope; keep secondary supporting copy readable and the headline dominant. Strong publication-quality typographic composition, not a generic template.
Text (verbatim):
"CAMBIOS DE ALCANCE"
"¿Puedes agregar esto también?"
"Una entrega más también cambia el trabajo."
"Antes de decir que sí, revisa lo acordado."
"HERRAMIENTAS RENTABLES"
"01 / 05"

slides.name: P03_02.png
slides.body:
Primary request: show a clean proposal excerpt from an illustrative freelance case, warm cream background with forest green text and restrained lime labels. Headline at top, one prominent forest-green proposal card with four short rows. Make the "5" and "2" bold. No numeric diagrams and no simulated app interface. Elegant stationery/editorial design.
Text (verbatim):
"Primero, lo acordado."
"Landing page"
"Hasta 5 secciones"
"2 rondas de revisión"
"Textos e imágenes del cliente"
"Ejemplo ilustrativo"
"HERRAMIENTAS RENTABLES"
"02 / 05"

slides.name: P03_03.png
slides.body:
Primary request: make the added work visible with precise typography and two stacked rows, dark forest green background. Short top headline and two cream panels with lime numeric accents, then an oversized "+8 h" total. These are written estimates, not bars, pie charts or proportional shapes. Use the same typographic family, footer and margins as the cover reference.
Text (verbatim):
"La nueva solicitud."
"+2 secciones"
"6 h estimadas"
"+1 ronda de revisión"
"2 h estimadas"
"+8 h"
"adicionales por evaluar"
"Ejemplo ilustrativo. Estima tus propias horas."
"HERRAMIENTAS RENTABLES"
"03 / 05"

slides.name: P03_04.png
slides.body:
Primary request: practical response to a scope change, warm cream background, huge forest headline and a polished quotation card. Four concise forest/lime editorial tags below it. Plenty of negative space with quotation readable at phone scale. Not a chat app UI; no profile/avatar, no speech bubble impersonation.
Text (verbatim):
"Acuerden el cambio antes de empezar."
"Podemos sumar 2 secciones y una ronda extra. Te enviaré el precio y el plazo con el alcance actualizado."
"Una respuesta que puedes adaptar"
"Alcance"
"Precio"
"Plazo"
"Revisiones"
"HERRAMIENTAS RENTABLES"
"04 / 05"

slides.name: P03_05.png
slides.body:
Primary request: high-impact ending slide on forest green with bold cream headline and lime accent. Elegant open editorial layout, no fake button. A restrained proposal-sheet motif supports three benefits in large readable text. Single action: use the free quote calculator from profile link. Do not show price claims or calculated results.
Text (verbatim):
"Recalcula antes de aceptar."
"Actualiza tiempo, costos y alcance."
"Cotizador gratuito"
"En español · Sin registro"
"Pruébalo con tu próximo proyecto."
"Enlace del perfil"
"HERRAMIENTAS RENTABLES"
"05 / 05"

reference_instruction: Input image 1 is a style reference only: match its elegant typography, green/cream/lime palette, fine print texture, footer and square dimensions. Create a NEW slide; do not reproduce its headline or extra card text.
